s06_f00e: Thousands of Parisians fled their homes today...
...It is complete chaos here, Jimmy.
...We do not even know whether the President can still hear us. Wait!
America has bowed before us.
We owe this to... ah...
Our victory is thanks to your outstanding leadership...
And...
...and General Vladimir.
Thank you, Premier!
Only your generosity can equal your greatness.
I have an announcement following our recent victory.
I hereby promote Yuri to commander in chief of the Soviet armed forces.
What!?
Effective immediately.
Yuri, this must be your doing!
I know your tricks better than anyone!
It seems our Vladimir is unhappy.
What a shame. General, we have important business to attend to.
The Allied Pacific Fleet is gathering near Hawaii.
Your next assignment is to destroy the Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor,
and establish a new Soviet foothold there.
s06_p01e: Comrade General, we have detected South Korean reinforcements on their way.
Once they reach Pearl Harbor, overcoming the Allied fleet will be much harder.
s06_p02e: Now that we control the airport on Kauai,
we can send paratroopers wherever we need them.
s06_p03e: we must move closer to the Tesla Coil to charge it.
Once it is charged, our weapon range will increase.
